name: formula-input
title: Formula Input
description: A calculated field's formula on one line — `{` inserts field chips, * and / read as × and ÷, the first row's result under it and the formula's error in its place.

meta.whenToUse: A calculated field's formula — field chips, numbers and + − × ÷ on one line, with the host's first-row result and error under it.
meta.whenNotToUse: Free text with placeholders (TemplateEditor), or a plain number (Input).
